open_questions: Game entity pool: chunk_052 uses a 0x230-byte entity at g_08716400 (pool base g_0864c384, client stride 0x28a4), while chunk_020/023 model gentity_s at a runtime stride (0x274 in chunk_023) and chunk_021/022 model sharedEntity_s with linked at 0xf0. The merge lane must decide whether these are the same object and which stride the server uses.

Bullet_FireFromEntity (0811f844) and Bullet_Fire_Extended (0811fe90) pass a 16-bit hit-location local that the decompile never writes before the call. Translated as 0; the binary passes indeterminate stack data. Needs a disassembly check of the stack slot (ebp-0x1c) at the call site.

Out-of-chunk signatures are guesses: fn_08120e7e (returns float in this chunk; could be long double), fn_0810a5cc/fn_0810a528 (trace argument order), fn_0809e05e, fn_08101c58 (10 args, hit-location passed as int), fn_080e129e. Confirm when the shared prototypes land.

Ghidra prints void for 0811d5cc, 0811d600, 0811d634 and 0811d5b4; the callers use their return values. Only 0811d5b4 was checked in disassembly (eax passes through). The other three return the callee eax by assumption.

The 0x0c..0x30 trajectory block at entity+0x0c is inferred from zeroing/copy patterns (type/time/duration then base and delta). Name and layout are unconfirmed against the game's own entity state definition.
